text: {"lessons":["Selling 40 shares of Stock D after a large gain locked in a profit, but that alone does not show whether the sale was wise; I should base future trades on my plan, not the satisfaction of realizing gains.","My account rose overall despite a decline in Period 7, which reminds me not to let one month's movement dictate a decision when I check in only occasionally.","I should assess each holding and my overall risk using current information and diversification, rather than anchoring on my purchase price or trying to predict random price changes."]}
